raw.query: SELECT c.run_id, c.forecast_model, ROUND(l.p99_ms) as ttft_p99_ms, ROUND(c.gpu_hours) as gpu_hours FROM provenance.v_pool_cost c JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON c.run_id = l.run_id WHERE c.run_id IN ('planner:week_fc_p90_toto', 'planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm') AND c.is_current = true AND l.is_current = true AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft' ORDER BY c.forecast_model;
raw.observed: TimesFM: 651 ms TTFT p99, 641 GPU-hours; Toto: 651 ms TTFT p99, 625 GPU-hours.
raw.claimed: Replacing Chronos with Toto or TimesFM holds the tail at the identical 651 ms (both pass), shifting only cost (625 and 641 GPU-hours).
raw.evidence: In the planner aggregate week experiment (planner:week_fc_p90_toto and planner:week_fc_p90_timesfm), both forecast models achieve an identical rounded TTFT p99 of 651 ms while consuming 625 and 641 GPU-hours respectively.
